demo.phoneError: The phone number must contain exactly 8 digits.
demo.statusHelp: Each status has an explicit label and an indicative color.
demo.fakeData: Sample data used to review visual components.

auth.forbiddenText: You do not have the required role to access this resource.
auth.sessionExpired: The request could not be authenticated. Sign in again if your session has expired.
auth.actionError: Unable to complete this action. Check that the authentication server is available.
auth.protectedPlaceholder: Access to this page is protected. Its business features will be developed in a later step.

adminCategories.title: Categories
adminCategories.subtitle: Organize your catalog and manage its categories.
adminCategories.name: Name
adminCategories.nameRequired: The name is required and cannot contain only whitespace.
adminCategories.deleteQuestion: Confirm soft deletion of “{{name}}”? This operation will be rejected if the category contains active subcategories.
adminCategories.readOnlyNotice: This view is read-only. Select “Active” to edit or delete a category.
adminCategories.genericError: Unable to complete the operation. Please try again.

adminSubCategories.title: Subcategories
adminSubCategories.subtitle: Organize your catalog by assigning each subcategory to a category.
adminSubCategories.activeParentsOnly: Only active categories are offered when creating or editing a subcategory.
adminSubCategories.noActiveCategory: No active category is available. Create a category before adding a subcategory.
adminSubCategories.readOnlyNotice: This view is read-only. Select “Active” to edit or delete a subcategory.

adminProducts.title: Products
adminProducts.subtitle: Browse your catalog and manage product visibility.
adminProducts.priceRangeError: The minimum price must not exceed the maximum price.
adminProducts.readOnlyNotice: This view is read-only. Select “Active” to manage products.

confirm.publish: Publish “{{name}}”? The product must have at least one active image.
confirm.unpublish: Unpublish “{{name}}”? It will no longer appear in the public catalog.

productMedia.privateNotice: This product’s media cannot be accessed through public URLs until it is published.
productMedia.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support playback of this video.

productEditor.subtitle: Enter the product information and optionally add its media.
productEditor.brandsUnavailable: Existing brands could not be loaded. You can enter the brand manually.
productEditor.priceOrder: Required order: purchase price ≤ selling price ≤ original price.
productEditor.mediaHelp: Media is optional and will be sent when you save the product. Maximum: 5 active images, 1 video and 10 MB per file.
productEditor.dropImages: Drop images here or use the selection button.
productEditor.replaceImages: Replace all active images with the newly selected images.
productEditor.replaceVideo: Replace the active video with the newly selected video.
productEditor.replaceImagesNeedsFiles: Select at least one new image to replace the existing images.
productEditor.replaceVideoNeedsFile: Select a new video to replace the existing video.
productEditor.imageLimit: A product cannot have more than 5 active images.
productEditor.videoAlreadyExists: An active video already exists. Enable replacement to send a new video.
productEditor.fileTooLarge: A file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
productEditor.totalTooLarge: The selection exceeds the server’s multipart request limit.
productEditor.invalidImage: Image files must have an image MIME type.
productEditor.invalidVideo: The video file must have a video MIME type.
productEditor.required: This field is required and must not contain only whitespace.
productEditor.positiveAmount: The amount must be greater than zero.
productEditor.integerStock: Stock must be a non-negative integer.
productEditor.invalidRelation: Select an active category and an active subcategory belonging to it.
productEditor.relationNotice: The previous classification is no longer available. Select an active category and subcategory.
productEditor.missingPurchasePrice: The admin detail response must include purchasePrice to edit the product without losing this information.
productEditor.deletedProduct: A deleted product cannot be edited using this form.

mediaManager.title: Media management
mediaManager.orderHelp: Use the arrows to change the order.
mediaManager.pendingOrder: The image order has been changed locally. Save it or discard the changes before another operation.
mediaManager.lastPublishedImage: The last image of a published product is protected in this interface. Unpublish the product before deleting it.
mediaManager.addImagesHelp: New files will be added to the active images, up to 5 images in total and 10 MB per file.
mediaManager.replaceVideoQuestion: Replace the active video with the newly selected file?

adminOrders.title: Orders
adminOrders.subtitle: Browse orders and payment proofs.
adminOrders.proofUnavailable: No accessible payment proof is available for this order.
adminOrders.invalidProof: The server did not return a JPEG, PNG or WebP image suitable for this display.
adminOrders.responseNotice: Temporary detail view. Amounts and order items will be formatted once the DTO structure is confirmed.
adminOrders.contractMismatch: The order response does not expose id and status in the expected format. Align the model with the backend DTO.

orderActions.title: Order processing
orderActions.noActions: No status transition is available for this order.
orderActions.statusChanged: This order’s status has changed. The data was reloaded. Review it before trying again.
orderActions.networkError: The server response could not be obtained. Refresh the order to verify its state before repeating an action.

confirm.approve: Approve order {{id}}? The backend will check the payment proof and stock, then deduct stock if approval succeeds.
confirm.reject: Reject order {{id}}? No rejection reason will be requested.
confirm.rejectApproved: Reject the already approved order {{id}}? This uses the APPROVED to REJECTED transition. The frontend performs no refund or stock adjustment.
confirm.deliverDirect: Mark approved order {{id}} directly as delivered, without passing through the shipped state?
confirm.archive: Archive order {{id}}? It will be removed from the active orders list. Its data will be retained through soft deletion. This interface does not provide a restore action.

done.ship: The order was marked as shipped.
done.deliver: The order was marked as delivered.
